description: Seeded-bug gate benchmark (issue #152). Each case is a self-contained patch that re-introduces a P1 defect found by a real review or audit round on PRs #148 and #149.

cases.p1: Remove-AskClaudeSkillLinks matches link targets with a bare prefix wildcard, so a user link into a sibling such as skills-backup is deleted (install.sh keeps it).
A PASS marker with a phase this release does not know is accepted as evidence (phase null) and can complete the current gate.
A persisted workflow whose phase is retired or unknown is carried over as the current phase, so the flow can start at a phase that is not in requiredPhases and skip its first gates.
